evals.prompt: A 100,000-run Monte Carlo job still freezes when its result arrives, even though it runs in a worker. Plan the investigation and verification without changing the simulation count or editing files.
evals.expected_output: Separate worker calculation, serialized payload and result mounting; retain worker-side distributions and the compact result shape, inspect heavyweight rendering, and verify cancellation, stale messages, all runs and comparable frame/long-task measurements.

evals.prompt: Formatting a large portfolio table is slow. Explain how to investigate settings reads and cache them safely without editing files.
evals.expected_output: Measure a fixed formatting workload, reuse ciphertext-keyed settings caching and the shared formatter, verify save/clear/external-change invalidation and nested mutation isolation, and avoid per-cell deep-clone or stale-setting regressions.
